rows.cochin_shipyard_limited_csl: CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram

content_sections.heading: CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Cochin Shipyard Limited has announced a total of 9 ITI Trade Apprentice vacancies in different trades.

content_sections.heading: CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, age and domicile requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must have passed 10th standard. Candidates must have passed ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in any one of the notified trades. The minimum age required for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026 is 18 years as on 21 September 2026. The applicant must be an Indian citizen domiciled in Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

content_sections.heading: CSL ITI Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected ITI Trade Apprentices will receive a stipend of ₹11,000 per month during the apprenticeship training period.

content_sections.heading: CSL Apprentice Training Duration
content_sections.text: The duration of apprenticeship training will be one year as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: CSL ITI Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026 will be conducted based on merit and certificate verification. Shortlisting based on percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification. Certificate Verification. Final selection based on merit, reservation and medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: CSL ITI Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the Cochin Shipyard Limited recruitment portal. Visit the official CSL website. Read the apprenticeship notification and user instructions. Complete one-time registration in the CSL SAP E-Recruitment portal. Select the applicable trade and submit the application. Upload required documents and photograph. Submit the application and keep a copy of the registration number for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026 is an apprenticeship recruitment drive by Cochin Shipyard Limited for ITI certificate holders under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 ITI Trade Apprentice vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CSL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th standard and ITI with National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the relevant trade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years as on 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for CSL ITI Trade Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive ₹11,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisting, certificate verification and merit subject to medical fitness.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 21 September 2026.
